# Long-form visual explainers

The job is sustained understanding. Use readable prose and integrated visual reasoning: calm enough to follow the argument, interactive where manipulating a relationship or watching a change adds understanding. The reader should not have to choose between reading and enjoying the presentation.

This is different from a quick internal ELI5 brief. Depth is appropriate here; unnecessary prose and distracting spectacle are not.

## Approved calibration pair

| Reference | What to borrow |
|---|---|
| [Load Balancing — Sam Rose](https://samwho.dev/load-balancing/) | Animated behavior as the subject of the explanation; a concrete system develops alongside the argument. |
| [A Friendly Introduction to Spring Physics — Josh W. Comeau](https://www.joshwcomeau.com/animation/a-friendly-introduction-to-spring-physics/) | A readable explanation connected to a manipulable object and immediate feedback. |

## Established references

| Reference | What to borrow |
|---|---|
| [Multimodal Neurons — Distill](https://distill.pub/2021/multimodal-neurons/) | Research seriousness, legible typography and visual investigation integrated into the reasoning. |
| [A Visual Exploration of Gaussian Processes — Distill](https://distill.pub/2019/visual-exploration-gaussian-processes/) | Small visual explanations that build intuition without turning the whole page into a show. |
| [How to Use t-SNE Effectively — Distill](https://distill.pub/2016/misread-tsne/) | Parameter changes and comparisons that make an otherwise opaque claim inspectable. |
| [A Visual Introduction to Machine Learning — R2D3](http://www.r2d3.us/visual-intro-to-machine-learning-part-1/) | Short passages coordinated with an evolving visualization; guide the reader rather than dropping them into a sandbox. |
| [Understanding UMAP — Google PAIR](https://pair-code.github.io/understanding-umap/) | Readable technical explanation with interactive figures where the behavior merits exploration. |

## Visual-intensity boundary

[Dithering — Part 1](https://visualrambling.space/dithering-part-1/) is an admired craft and motion reference whose visual intensity competed with reading in calibration. Borrow an explanatory transition or visual technique, not its overall intensity as a default. The desired middle ground retains aliveness while leaving the idea in charge of attention.
